note: Each final is a grayscale crop of the same photograph used on the corresponding Apple poster scan. Apple lockups and campaign text were removed; no other subject retouching. Credits appear only here and in README.md, never on the pages.

photos.subject: Albert Einstein
photos.rights: Rights-managed. Philippe Halsman estate / Magnum Photos; Apple poster (c) Apple Computer, Inc. No permission granted.
photos.notes: Apple poster scan used; the LOC digitization is a different Halsman exposure from the same 1947 sitting, so it is sitting evidence only.

photos.subject: Mahatma Gandhi
photos.rights: Rights-managed. Margaret Bourke-White / LIFE Picture Collection (TIME Inc.). No permission granted.

photos.subject: Muhammad Ali
photos.rights: Rights-managed. (c) Thomas Hoepker / Magnum Photos. No permission granted.
photos.notes: Correction to the working brief: the poster's vertical line is only '(c)1998 Apple Computer, Inc. All rights reserved.' and does not name Bingham. The image is Hoepker's 1966 Chicago 'mighty fist' photograph (Magnum/Guardian/Atlas Gallery). Final is a crop of the clean 2048px source, upscaled to 1600 long edge.

photos.subject: Amelia Earhart
photos.photographer: Unknown photographer (Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum)
photos.rights: No known copyright restrictions stated by the Smithsonian; published c. 1930. Rights status not formally cleared.
photos.notes: Leather flight helmet and goggles; Smithsonian records the photographer as unknown.

photos.subject: Pablo Picasso
photos.rights: Rights-managed. (c) Yousuf Karsh estate. No permission granted.
photos.notes: Karsh, Vallauris, July 1954. The supplied posters-hires/picasso scan is a different Picasso photograph (striped shirt) and was rejected; this is the hand-on-forehead frame used on the poster. Native 1080x1628 scan; final 1055x1589.

photos.subject: John Lennon and Yoko Ono
photos.rights: Rights-managed. Photographer not established; Amsterdam Hilton bed-in, March 1969. No permission granted.
photos.notes: Flower close-up. Nico Koster and Govert de Roos both photographed the Amsterdam bed-in; the exact frame has not been attributed, so no photographer is named rather than guessing.

photos.subject: Bob Dylan
photos.rights: Rights-managed. Photographer not established; Apple poster (c) Apple Computer, Inc. No permission granted.
photos.notes: Harmonica and neck rack, upturned profile. The Don Hunstein harmonica print sold by Rockarchive is a different frame from the same era, so no Hunstein attribution is claimed. The poster carries only Apple (c)1998.

photos.subject: Alfred Hitchcock
photos.rights: Rights-managed. (c) Philippe Halsman estate / Magnum Photos. No permission granted.
photos.notes: Profile against the stone wall. Attributed to Halsman's 1963 Hitchcock sitting on the strength of the Guardian pairing and the visual match; not confirmed by a museum record for this exact frame.

photos.subject: Jim Henson and Kermit
photos.rights: Rights status unclear. National Portrait Gallery credits an unknown photographer, bromide press print, 1979. No permission granted.
photos.notes: White studio, turtleneck, Kermit on the shoulder. NPG records an unknown photographer for its 1979 bromide print; the exact frame is not independently confirmed.

photos.subject: Martha Graham
photos.rights: Rights-managed. (c) Barbara Morgan estate. No permission granted.
photos.notes: Letter to the World (Kick), 1940. Verified same photo as the poster; kept as an unused alternate because the brief's verse map has no slot for her.

photos.subject: Miles Davis
photos.rights: Rights-managed. Photographer not established; Apple poster (c) Apple Computer, Inc. No permission granted.
photos.notes: White shirt, trumpet and sheet music. Verified same photo as the poster; kept as an unused alternate because the verse map has no slot for him.
